subtasks.title: Implement Semantic Search Logic
subtasks.description: Develop code to perform semantic search using embeddings for similarity retrieval.
subtasks.details:
Implement a function that takes an embedding as input and retrieves top similar vectors from Qdrant using cosine similarity.
<info added on 2025-11-11T18:06:43.501Z>
Implement a function that performs keyword-based search by querying Qdrant using text filters and metadata fields such as age, region, timestamp, and comorbidity. This logic should complement the semantic search by enabling retrieval based on explicit textual criteria.
</info added on 2025-11-11T18:06:43.501Z>
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with sample embeddings to ensure accurate similarity ranking.

subtasks.title: Implement Keyword-Based Search Logic
subtasks.description: Develop code to perform keyword-based search using filters on metadata.
subtasks.details:
Implement a function that takes keyword filters (e.g., age, region, timestamp) and retrieves matching vectors from Qdrant.
<info added on 2025-11-11T18:07:39.857Z>
The `_keyword_search()` method has been successfully implemented, enabling filter-based search using Qdrant's `search_with_filters()` functionality. A `RetrievalOptions` dataclass was created to manage a wide range of filter options, including age, region, comorbidity, diagnosis, time range, entity type/value, and knowledge base filters (domain, source, year_range). The `to_filters()` method was developed to convert these options into Qdrant-compatible filter formats, supporting range filters (gte, lte), "in" filters for lists, and exact match filters. Specialized retrieval methods such as `retrieve_by_entity_type()`, `retrieve_by_time_range()`, and `retrieve_by_demographics()` were also implemented to enable targeted filtering based on specific criteria.
</info added on 2025-11-11T18:07:39.857Z>
subtasks.testStrategy: Test with various filter combinations to ensure correct query results.

subtasks.title: Combine Semantic and Keyword Search
subtasks.description: Integrate semantic and keyword-based search to enable hybrid retrieval.
subtasks.details:
Merge the two search methods into a unified function that supports both similarity and filter-based queries.
<info added on 2025-11-11T18:08:24.331Z>
- Integrated Qdrant's `hybrid_search()` method from Task 4 into the unified retrieval function
- Added support for configurable weights between semantic (0.7 default) and keyword (0.3 default) search components
- Implemented `RetrievalMode` enum to control between SEMANTIC, KEYWORD, and HYBRID search modes
- Enhanced `retrieve_similar_cases()` to automatically select the appropriate search mode based on input parameters
- Included both semantic_score and keyword_score in search results for transparency and analysis
- Implemented result re-ranking based on combined scores from both search components
</info added on 2025-11-11T18:08:24.331Z>
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate hybrid search with test cases that require both semantic and filter-based conditions.

subtasks.title: Implement Retrieval Ranking and Filtering
subtasks.description: Sort and filter retrieved results based on relevance and metadata constraints.
subtasks.details:
Develop logic to rank results by similarity and apply additional metadata filters (e.g., domain, year) to narrow down results.
<info added on 2025-11-11T18:09:29.207Z>
The implementation includes a `_format_results()` method that transforms raw Qdrant results into structured `RetrievalResult` objects, enabling consistent handling of retrieved data. The `RetrievalResult` dataclass contains fields such as `case_id`, `score`, `semantic_score`, `keyword_score`, and `combined_score`, along with the full case data, metadata, and modalities (text, image, audio). Results are automatically ranked by similarity score in descending order, ensuring the most relevant cases appear first. A `score_threshold` option allows filtering results based on a minimum similarity score. The results include comprehensive metadata relevant for clinical decision-making, such as timestamp, age group, region, comorbidities, diagnosis, outcome, medical entities, SOAP notes, and multi-modal content. The `to_dict()` method is provided for easy serialization of results, facilitating further processing or integration with other systems.
</info added on 2025-11-11T18:09:29.207Z>
subtasks.testStrategy: Validate ranking and filtering with test cases that simulate real-world query scenarios.

Test and validation sessions with medical experts have been successfully completed, confirming the accuracy and relevance of retrieval results for clinical use cases. Automated test cases have been executed, demonstrating robust performance across semantic, keyword, and hybrid retrieval modes. The retrieval module is fully implemented, with comprehensive filtering capabilities and a clean, high-level API for clinical case retrieval. All results are properly formatted with complete clinical information, and the module is now ready for integration testing.

subtasks.testStrategy: Use medical test cases and performance benchmarks to validate accuracy and scalability.
